title: Trump urges Congress to pass the Clarity Act at a White House event with execs including the CEOs of Coinbase and Robinhood; the bill has stalled in the Senate (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Trump urges Congress to pass the Clarity Act at a White House event with execs including the CEOs of Coinbase and Robinhood; the bill has stalled in the Senate — President Donald Trump pressed Congress to pass digital asset market structure legislation that is a top priority for the industry …
